description: After /workflow, blocks code edits, shell writes into project files, MCP write tools and git writes until the current task's PLAN.md Approval line approves a revision and quotes words from a real user message (canonical task records use record.py instead of direct Write/Edit/MultiEdit in active workflow sessions; see skills/workflow/SETUP.md, What the hooks enforce), and blocks package installs and npx-style downloads unless the user's latest words allow installing. When the project root AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md declares required reads, blocks entering workflow-specify, workflow-execute or workflow-deliver, and validating or rendering a report while one is loaded, until each declared file was read whole in the current context. Warns the agent (never blocks): partial reads of workflow-axa instruction files, in-place task-record edits, and, when a phase skill loads, the exact files that phase must read; and, in workflow sessions, a one-time rewrite request when the last reply has contractions, em-dashes or semicolons. Duplicate skill copies: at session start, names every second copy of a workflow-axa skill in the personal or project skills folders and asks the owner to delete it (never deletes anything itself), and warns when the imported shared rules copy differs from the plugin's; while a copy exists, blocks loading workflow-clarify, workflow-specify, workflow-execute and bare duplicate names until the copies are gone or the owner sends a message that is only "continue with duplicates" (valid for that session, at most 12 hours).
